claim_contract.project_record_ids: complete ordered ownership set for every claim
claim_contract.locus_mapping: Project claims use that project loci. Candidate claims use candidate-owned expanded facet refs. Aggregate claims use the ordered union of only relevant candidate-owned expanded refs.
claim_contract.facet_result_rule: S+A iff candidate dispositions contain both S and A; S iff they contain S and no A; N iff every disposition is X. Each result claim derives from every candidate-disposition claim for that facet.
claim_contract.coverage_requirement: Every declared claim-bearing source field appears once in coverage_ledger; every claim ID appears in exactly one coverage entry; mapped=total and ownership violations=0.
claim_contract.structured_non_claim_fields: metadata, behavior_ref, ref_relation, licence, raw loci and stored legacy hashes are sealed evidence metadata, not prose claim atoms.
